title: Build an interactive air quality map — quickmap
code: quickmap(   layers,   boroughs,   pollutant = NULL,   display_times = NULL,   colour_scale = "who_no2",   output_file = "quickmap.html",   title = NULL,   styling_type = "html",   export_image = NULL,   marker_labels = NULL,   vignette = NULL,   banner_colour = NULL,   boundary_labels = NULL,   autoplay = NULL,   play_speed = NULL,   theme_file = NULL,   data_symbols = NULL,   wind = NULL )

title: Build an interactive air quality map — quickmap
text: layers One layer list layers. element may file path (CSV RData, resolved DATA_PATH), qm_layer(), data.frame/sf object (converted via qm_layer()). boroughs Character vector borough names ("") pollutant Pollutant display. NULL (default) infers first time-varying layer's value column. display_times Time periods display (NULL = available) colour_scale Name bundled colour scale (see inst/config/scales/) output_file HTML file name written aq_maps/ title Banner title styling_type "html" (banner + legend + time control) "none" export_image NULL, TRUE, c(width, height) JPG export marker_labels FALSE, TRUE (hover), "values_on", "labels", "labels_on" vignette Dim area outside boundary banner_colour Banner background colour boundary_labels Show boundary name labels autoplay Auto-advance time control play_speed Autoplay interval ms theme_file Path YAML theme file data_symbols Optional character vector marker symbols per layer (default: automatic assignment — solid symbols time-varying layers, outline symbols static layers) wind Optional wind layer: from_worldmet() object data frame date/ws/wd columns. Rendered animated particle overlay (leaflet-velocity) advances time control. Interactive HTML — omitted static JPG exports.

code: if (FALSE) { # two lines: a usable map library(quickmap) quickmap("wandsworth_2017_2024.csv", boroughs = "Wandsworth")  # several layers plus styling quickmap(   list("merton_dt_2018_2024.csv", "bl_sensors.Rdata", "schools_Merton.csv"),   boroughs = "Merton",   colour_scale = "who_no2",   title = "Merton NO2",   output_file = "merton_no2.html" )  # expert: hand-built atomic unit quickmap(qm_layer(my_data, value_col = "pm25"), boroughs = "Richmond") }

what: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
text: Main function create Leaflet maps showing air pollution data optional schools overlay. Generates interactive HTML maps static JPG exports.

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
code: render_pollution_map(   data_sources = NULL,   data_ids = NULL,   data_symbols = NULL,   data_dynamic = NULL,   output_file = "pollution_map.html",   export_image = NULL,   boroughs,   pollutant = "no2",   display_times = NULL,   title = NULL,   vignette = NULL,   colour_scale = "who_no2",   styling_type = "html",   marker_labels = NULL,   banner_colour = NULL,   boundary_labels = NULL,   autoplay = NULL,   play_speed = NULL,   theme_file = NULL,   wind = NULL )

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
text: data_sources List file paths sf objects. Files can CSV (diffusion tubes, schools) RData (sensor data). Prepends DATA_PATH set. data_ids Character vector layer IDs (default: NULL, auto-generated filenames). data_symbols Character vector marker symbols (default: NULL, auto-cycles defaults). Valid: "circle", "diamond", "cross", "square", "triangle", "star", "plus". data_dynamic Logical vector indicating temporal (TRUE) vs static (FALSE) layers (default: NULL, auto-detected). output_file Output filename (without extension). Saved 'aq_maps/' directory. export_image NULL (export), TRUE (export 1200x1200), c(width, height) vector custom dimensions. boroughs Borough name(s) boundary display data filtering (required). pollutant Pollutant type: "no2" "pm25" (default: "no2"). display_times Time periods display (e.g., "2023", "2023-01", "2023-01-15 10:00"). NULL uses available periods data. Must match year_str format data. title Page title banner text. Default: NULL (uses theme). vignette TRUE, darkens areas outside borough(s). Default: NULL (uses theme). colour_scale Color scale name (default: "who_no2"). See load_colour_scale() options. styling_type Controls banner/legend display: "html" (default) "none". marker_labels Label visibility: FALSE, TRUE (hover), "values_on" (always), "labels" (custom/hover), "labels_on" (custom/always). Default: NULL (uses theme). Content: School/Label/pollutant columns. banner_colour Color banner vignette. Default: NULL (uses theme). boundary_labels TRUE, shows borough boundary labels. Default: NULL (uses theme). autoplay Auto-start year animation load. Default: NULL (uses theme). play_speed Milliseconds per year animation. Default: NULL (uses theme). theme_file Path YAML theme file (default: NULL). See inst/themes/ examples.

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
text: Invisible Leaflet map object. Side effects: Saves HTML aq_maps/. export_image NULL, also saves JPG files (one per year).

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
text: Data Files: CSV files (diffusion tubes, schools) require Easting/Northing columns. RData files (sensors) require 'dataOAformat' object. School data auto-detected School column. Coordinates: Input British National Grid (EPSG:27700), output WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Setup: Set Sys.setenv(DATA_PATH = "~/path//data") use. Symbols: Auto-assigned data type. Override data_symbols parameter.

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
text: Year columns CSV files must YYYY format (e.g., "2024"). Static JPG exports require Chrome/Chromium webshot2.

title: Create interactive and/or static pollution maps — render_pollution_map
code: # Basic interactive map (annual) Sys.setenv(DATA_PATH = "~/data") create_pollution_map(   data_sources = list("wandsworth_2017_2024.csv", "schools_Wandsworth.csv"),   boroughs = "Wandsworth",   display_times = "2024",   output_file = "wandsworth_2024.html" ) #> Warning: cannot open file '/Users/iarla/data/wandsworth_2017_2024.csv': No such file or directory #> Error in file(file, "rt"): cannot open the connection  # Monthly data (sub-annual) create_pollution_map(   data_sources = list("sensor_monthly.Rdata"),   boroughs = "Merton",   display_times = c("2024-01", "2024-02", "2024-03"),   output_file = "merton_q1_2024" ) #> Warning: cannot open compressed file '/Users/iarla/data/sensor_monthly.Rdata', probable reason 'No such file or directory' #> Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE): cannot open the connection
